messages:
leo (devex): Ran the runbook link scanner this morning — found 4 404s and one outdated OAuth curl snippet in /runbooks/incident-retros. Who's the owner for that runbook?

mara (docs): I own incident-retros. Thanks for the ping. Which 4 paths are 404ing?

leo (devex): Paths: /assets/ir/screenshot-steps.png, /assets/ir/diag-v2.svg, /shortlink/runbooks/incident-retros#step-3, and /guides/oncall-handoff (S3->new bucket). OAuth snippet shows old token endpoint (api.redwood.example.com/token) and no Content-Type header.

sam (oncall): I can take the S3 redirects — looks like the bucket rename happened in the infra rollout last week. Will put the shortlink /assets -> new-bucket mapping in the redirect table. ETA today EOD.

mara (docs): Awesome. For the OAuth snippet: we need to change endpoint to token.redwood.example.com and add 'Content-Type: application/json' plus a short note about using ephemeral tokens for playbooks. I can author the doc patch but prefer someone to open the PR so I can review quickly.

leo (devex): I'll open the PR and include the redirects as separate commits. Drafting now — will tag you for review, @mara. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

docs-bot: Preview build for PR #4321 complete — staging URL: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.example.com/runbooks/incident-retros :white_check_mark:

mara (docs): Checked the preview. Snippet content looks right; left one nit on spacing in the curl block. Also the screenshot replacement path needs the new filename (screenshot-steps-v3.png) — @sam can you confirm it's in the new bucket?

sam (oncall): Confirmed. Uploaded screenshot-steps-v3.png and diag-v2.svg to new-bucket/assets/ir/, and added the redirect rules for the old S3 keys. Tested both URLs — 200 OK. :rocket:

ben (product): Quick Q — will any of these changes touch public docs or customer-facing KBs? Want to check if we need to call out in release notes.

mara (docs): This is internal runbook only. No public docs impacted. I'll add a short changelog entry in the repo (docs/CHANGELOG.md) as part of the PR.

leo (devex): Great. Merging in ~30m if no objections. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :clap:

mara (docs): Thanks — will follow up after merge and mark the runbook ownership in the docs index.

docs-bot: PR #4321 merged by leo (devex) — deployed to production runbooks. :tada:

mara (docs): Verified live. All links resolved and snippet updated. Closing the loop.
